# evroc_placement_group (Data Source)

Retrieves information about an existing evroc placement group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the placement group to query.

### Optional

- `project` (String) Project this resource belongs to. Defaults to the provider project.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Timestamp when the placement group was created.
- `fqid` (String) Fully qualified resource ID (FQID).
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `pg_id` (String) Unique identifier of the placement group.
- `region` (String) Region where the placement group is located.
- `strategy` (String) Placement strategy of the placement group.
- `zone` (String) Zone of the placement group.
